incident_note.summary: Run CTX-20260910-06 was previously executed by TWO colliding agent processes sharing one browser profile due to an orchestrator resume bug, producing interleaved/overlapping actions on the same object range (clipart-category ids 6012-6019) and inconsistent evidence capture (20 ACT-IDs had screenshots but only 9-18 had matching network files, and several ACTs had only a 'before' or only an 'after' screenshot, never both).
how_this_run_handled_it: Did not trust any prior process's narrative or conclusions. Re-logged in fresh (npx playwright test --project=setup) and re-verified sub=273/user_id=266 before touching anything.

Independently audited every id named in the handoff (6012-6019) via direct browser navigation + captured GET /api/clipart-categories/:id responses (raw/network/AUDIT-*.json, raw/portal/shots/AUDIT-*.png, raw/portal/dom/AUDIT-*.txt) before deciding what to keep.
Result: 6012, 6013, 6014, 6015, 6018, 6019 all exist intact (200, correct type/name). 6016 and 6017 both return 404 'No query results for model'.

For 6016 specifically (flagged by the handoff as 'nghi bị corrupt do race condition'): cross-referencing the OLD network evidence that DOES have full before+after screenshots (ACT-02-01-003: clone 6015->6016, POST 201; ACT-02-01-004: delete 6016, DELETE 204) shows a clean, single, successful create-then-delete sequence with no partial-write or orphan signature. The 404 is consistent with an ordinary, intentional delete-flow test, not with corruption. This run does NOT conclude 'corrupted' — it concludes 'deleted as designed, evidenced by a complete ACT with before/after+network', while still flagging in the observation that the original hand-off's 'possible corruption' hypothesis could not be independently confirmed as corruption from the portal surface.
For 6017 (clone of Color, claimed already deleted): 404 confirmed independently this session, consistent with the claim.

Of the 20 pre-existing ACT-IDs with screenshots, only 11 had BOTH before+after screenshots AND a matching, content-sane network file (ACT-02-01-002/003/004, ACT-02-03-002/003, ACT-03-01-001, ACT-03-02-001, ACT-03-03-001, ACT-04-01-001, ACT-04-02-001, ACT-05-01-001). These were kept as-is after spot-checking their network JSON for redaction correctness and plausible request/response shape. The remaining 9 (ACT-02-01-001, ACT-02-03-004/005/006, ACT-02-04-001/002, ACT-02-05-001/002, ACT-03-04-001) lack a complete before+after pair and were EXCLUDED from the final ACT list per the 'no before/after = did not happen' rule; where the gap mattered for this run's scope (clipart/color/addopt/mapstyle/vector/font category CREATE, and the Add-new bug re-verify), the action was re-run fresh this session under a new descriptive ACT-ID instead of reusing the old numbering.
TASK-1 (route relationship) and TASK-3 (Add-new disabled re-verify) were both independently redone this session from scratch, not inferred from old evidence, per explicit instruction.
incident_note.capture_gap_this_session: ACT-VECTOR-04 (delete clone 6026) and ACT-FONT-04 (delete clone 6028): the confirm-modal click succeeded (screenshots show the confirm dialog and a subsequent success toast) but the raw DELETE request/response itself was not present in this session's own network recorder output, likely because the response arrived just after the recorder was stopped for that step.
